title: Patient Registration with Unique Identifier Validation
description: Verify that the system validates unique patient identifiers (e.g., CPF) and prevents duplicate patient registrations.

steps.description: Navigate to the patient registration page.
Enter valid patient data with a unique CPF.
Submit the patient registration form.
Confirm patient registration succeeds with no duplicates.
Attempt to register another patient with the same CPF.
Check that the system prevents registration and displays a duplicate identifier error message.

title: Appointment Scheduling with Conflict Prevention
description: Ensure the scheduling system prevents conflicts and supports recurring appointments with notifications.

steps.description: Navigate to the appointment scheduling page.
Create an appointment for a timeslot.
Try to create another appointment for the same resource and overlapping timeslot.
Verify that the system prevents overlapping appointments and shows an error.
Schedule a recurring appointment (weekly) for a patient.
Confirm all instances of recurring appointments appear correctly in weekly and daily calendar views.
Check that notifications are sent to the patient and clinician for upcoming recurring appointments.

title: Clinical Documentation Editing and AI-Generated Report Accuracy
description: Verify rich text clinical notes editor functions correctly including auto-save, version control, and that AI-generated reports meet accuracy criteria.

steps.description: Open a patient's clinical note in the SOAP editor.
Edit clinical notes using rich text features (bold, lists, templates).
Wait and confirm auto-save triggers without loss of data.
Modify the clinical note multiple times to generate version history.
Verify version control allows restoring previous versions.
Request AI-generated report from the clinical note using Google Gemini integration.
Check that the AI generated report is clinically relevant and accurate with ≥95% reliability.

title: User Authentication and Role-Based Access Control with Two-Factor Authentication
description: Validate user login, role-based permissions, session management, and two-factor authentication enforcement.

steps.description: Attempt to login with valid credentials for different roles: Administrator, Physiotherapist, Intern, Patient.
Ensure login success and redirection to role-appropriate dashboard.
Attempt to access pages beyond user role permissions.
Verify access is denied with appropriate error or redirection.
Perform login flow with two-factor authentication enabled.
Validate that login completes only if the two-factor authentication token is provided correctly.
Test session timeout and logout behavior.
Confirm users are logged out automatically after inactivity and cannot access protected pages.

title: Payment Processing with Stripe and PIX Integration
description: Test secure payment processing, subscription handling, and accurate financial record updates for Stripe and PIX methods.

steps.description: Navigate to the payment checkout page.
Make a payment using Stripe with valid card details.
Confirm payment is processed successfully and transaction is recorded in system.
Make a payment using PIX with valid credentials.
Verify payment confirmation and update of financial dashboard.
Cancel or modify a subscription and verify the update reflects correctly.
Check that subscription management actions are reflected accurately in system reports.

title: Teleconsultation Session Stability and Logging with Jitsi Integration
description: Ensure teleconsultation sessions connect reliably via Jitsi, manage session states, and record logs appropriately.

steps.description: Initiate a teleconsultation session between a physiotherapist and a patient.
Verify connection stability and that audio, video, and chat function correctly.
Simulate network interruption and recovery.
Confirm session resumes smoothly or prompts reconnection.
Terminate the teleconsultation session.
Check that session metadata, duration, and logs are saved correctly in the system.

title: Patient Portal Security and Data Accuracy
description: Validate patient portal access security and accurate display of personal clinical data, exercises, and appointments.

steps.description: Login to the patient portal using valid patient credentials.
Ensure access to only patient's own clinical history, exercise prescriptions, and appointment schedules.
Attempt to access other patients' data via URL manipulation or API.
Verify the system denies access and protects patient privacy.
Check data accuracy by comparing portal data to backend data.
Confirm exercise tracking and appointment details match backend records.

title: System Performance: Page Load and Concurrent User Handling
description: Verify the system loads pages within 2 seconds and supports at least 100 concurrent users with 99.5% uptime.

steps.description: Simulate multiple users (100+) accessing various platform pages concurrently using load testing tools.
Verify that each page loads within 2 seconds on average.
Confirm system uptime and availability metrics meet 99.5% SLA.

title: Data Encryption, GDPR/LGPD Compliance, and Audit Logs Validation
description: Ensure that data is encrypted, user consents are managed per GDPR/LGPD, and audit logs capture critical operations.

steps.description: Verify encryption of sensitive data at rest and in transit using security scanning tools.
Review privacy consent prompts and data access workflows for compliance.
Perform various operations like patient data modification, payment transactions, and login/logout.
Check audit logs capture detailed entries with timestamps and user identification for each operation.

title: Backup and Data Recovery Process Robustness
description: Test automated backup routines run daily, verify successful backups, and validate recovery procedures with error handling.

steps.description: Trigger or await scheduled backup execution.
Confirm backup files are created and stored successfully without errors.
Simulate data loss or corruption scenario.
Execute recovery process from latest backup.
Verify data integrity is restored and system resumes normal operation.
Test behavior when backup storage is unavailable.
Ensure error handling notifies administrators and logs backup failure.

title: Exercise Library Search, Categorization, and Contraindication Alerts
description: Validate exercise library features including search, multimedia support, categorization, and alerts for contraindications in prescriptions.

steps.description: Access the exercise library page.
Search exercises by name, category, and body area.
Confirm accurate and relevant search results.
Verify exercises display multimedia content (images, videos).
Create a personalized exercise prescription selecting multiple exercises.
Check the system alerts if any exercise has contraindications based on patient data.

title: Interactive Body Map Pain Tracking Feature
description: Test the interactive body map for pain and injury tracking for accuracy, usability, and data persistence.

steps.description: Open a patient record and access the body map tool.
Mark pain areas and severity on the body map.
Verify markings are saved and visualized correctly on subsequent visits.
Test updating and clearing markings.
Confirm changes are reflected and logged for clinical tracking.

title: Real-Time Notifications and Task Management System
description: Ensure notifications and task reminders are delivered promptly and can be managed across all user roles.

steps.description: Trigger notifications by scheduling appointments, payment due dates, or system alerts.
Check notifications are received in real-time with accurate content on the notification center.
Mark notifications as read or dismiss them.
Verify status updates are registered and reflected accordingly.
Create, update, and assign tasks to users.
Ensure task notifications appear for assigned users and task status updates propagate correctly.

title: Risk Analysis and Stratification Alerts
description: Validate the accuracy and timely generation of patient risk analysis alerts using clinical data and AI stratification.

steps.description: Access risk analysis page for a patient.
Input/update relevant clinical data that influences risk scores.
Verify AI generates risk stratification with correct severity levels and alerts.
Confirm alerts are visible in clinical dashboards and trigger appropriate notifications.
